title: fix(app-shell,plugin-detail): Setup deletes confirm in-app and name what goes
body:
Closes #13333
Clause-②: no

Setup's metadata deletes no longer use the browser's native `confirm()`, and the related list's row delete names the row instead of asking "Are you sure you want to delete this record?". Every confirm here is the console's in-app `AlertDialog` from `@object-ui/components`, the idiom `PackagesPage` uses (`PackagesPage.tsx` is untouched).

## What changed

- **`ResourceEditPage.tsx`**: Reset overlay / Delete and Discard draft open one in-app `AlertDialog` (`resource-edit-confirm-dialog`). Reset / Delete is titled with the type label and the item's own label, e.g. `Delete Object "Account (customized)"?`, with the machine `type/name` in the body. Discard keeps its objectui#12690 title (`Discard the pending draft for {item}?`). `doReset` / `doDiscardDraft` now only open the dialog; `runReset(resetSemantic)` / `runDiscardDraft(item)` do the work, and the reset/delete branch taken is the verdict the dialog was opened with.
- **`ResourceHistoryPage.tsx`** (`HistoryPanel`): Rollback is confirmed in-app, titled `Restore {type/name} to version {n}?`, with the host's `rollbackConfirm` copy as the body.
- **`MetadataTypeActions.tsx`**: an action's `confirmText` is asked in-app through a promise-backed dialog, titled `{action} on "{recordId}"?` in the record header and `{action}?` on the list toolbar.
- **`datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx`**: Delete is confirmed in-app, titled `Delete datasource "{label or name}"?`, with the name in the body.
- **`i18n.ts`** (metadata-admin): new and reworded `engine.edit.*Confirm*`, `engine.datasource.delete*` and `engine.typeAction.confirmTitle*` rows, in en-US and zh-CN.
- **Shared record delete confirm: `packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`**: this is the source of "Delete record / Are you sure you want to delete this record?". The sentence now names the row by `getRecordDisplayName(objectSchema, row)`, the ADR-0079 resolver the record header uses. A grant row (`sys_user_permission_set`) declares a `nameField` formula that names the grant and its user, so the sentence says which grant goes and from whom.
- **`detail.deleteRowConfirmation`** now takes `{{name}}`, in all ten `packages/i18n` locale packs and in `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`. It has no other consumer.
- **`.changeset/13333-named-delete-confirm.md`**: patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Tests

- **Updated (they stubbed `window.confirm` for these flows):** `ResourceEditPage.resetVerdict`, `.resetPackage-12335`, `.layersUnsaved-11799`, `.discardFeedback-12303` and `.discardDraftLabel-12690`. They now answer the dialog and read its title and body. `window.confirm` stays stubbed only as a tripwire, and the tests assert it is never called.
- **Updated:** `de-quote-pairing-3876` pins the de pack's paired-quote census. The new `„{{name}}“` adds one correctly paired span, so the pinned count goes from 91 to 92.
- **New:** `ResourceHistoryPage.rollbackConfirm-13333` covers the rollback dialog. It also holds the **grep pin** the card's "Done when" names: the four metadata-admin files have no native `confirm()` call after comment masking. A control checks the pattern, and the same pattern matches 2/1/1/1 calls on the base files.
- **New:** `MetadataTypeActions.confirmDialog-13333`, `DatasourceResourcePage.deleteConfirm-13333` and `plugin-detail RelatedList.deleteConfirmNamed-13333`. Each covers the named title or sentence, accept runs once, Cancel runs nothing, and native confirm is never called.
- **Run from the repo root:** `pnpm exec vitest run` over every `ResourceEditPage.*`, `MetadataTypeActions.*` and `ResourceHistoryPage*` test, `zh-base-term.i18n-13131`, `metadata-admin/datasource/`, `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/`, `packages/i18n/src/` and `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`. Result: 315 files passed, 2 failed (both in `de-quote-pairing-3876`). With the census pin updated, that file has 9/9 passing.
- **Type-check:** `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n`: 32/32 tasks successful.
- **Lint:** ESLint on the touched files reports 0 errors.

## Not in this PR

- `DetailView.handleDelete` (plugin-detail) still uses `window.confirm` with `detail.deleteConfirmation`. The console record page does not use that path: `RecordDetailView` asks `recordDelete.confirmCopy`, which already names the record.
- `RuntimeDraftBar`, `MarketplacePackagePage` and `StudioDesignSurface` also call native `confirm()`. They are outside this card's surface.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
